description: pyeia is a Python client for querying the United States Energy Information Administration API. The README documents API-key configuration and methods for requesting EIA energy series for research or policy work. Users select EIA series and an API key; outputs are returned energy observations and metadata for the chosen endpoint. Geographic coverage depends on the EIA product, with many United States series. The package metadata states a BSD-3-Clause-LBNL licence, while EIA data have their own provider terms. A limitation is that the README calls this package work in progress and cites an old API workflow; compatibility with current EIA endpoints needs checking. This client can prepare load, generation or fuel series for infrastructure simulations. The related ERA5 catalogue record contains weather reanalysis, not EIA energy reports. No API key or energy data were handled.
